mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the permission matrix fact removes the closed-world assignment of PermMatrix.Allowed. Injecting a row that grants Outsider access to GetTask forces a world in which a cross-team caller can read a task, directly violating LeastPrivilege and NoInformationLeakage.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { Outsider -> GetTask in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries removes the uniqueness constraint on (aeTask, aeActor, aeOp, aeActorRole) tuples. Injecting two AuditEntries with identical (task, actor, operation, actorRole) forces a duplicate that models an 'edit' of an existing entry, violating append-only immutability.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.aeTask = ae2.aeTask and ae1.aeActor = ae2.aeActor and ae1.aeOp = ae2.aeOp and ae1.aeActorRole = ae2.aeActorRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AttributionCorrectness allows an AuditEntry's aeActorRole to differ from the actor's actual userRole. Injecting an entry where a Member actor has aeActorRole = TeamAdmin forces a misattribution counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeActor.userRole = Member and ae.aeActorRole = TeamAdmin }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_ShareesSameTeam removes the constraint that sharedWith users must be in the task's team. Injecting a task where a user from a different team appears in sharedWith forces a cross-team share, violating FR-012.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShareViolation { some t: Task | some u: User | u in t.sharedWith and u.userTeam != t.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_TaskOwnerSameTeam allows a task owner to be in a different team than the task. Injecting such a task violates the ownership-team consistency invariant that cross-team isolation depends on.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnerTeamMismatch { some t: Task | t.taskOwner.userTeam != t.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_DeletedTaskHasDeletedEntry allows a DeletedTask to exist without any OpDeleted AuditEntry, breaking the invariant that task deletion is always recorded in the audit log.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DeletedTaskNoAudit { some t: DeletedTask | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeTask = t and ae.aeOp = OpDeleted }
